profile.headline: DFIR Enthusiast | Digital Forensics & Incident Response | SOC & Blue Team Operations | Windows & Network Forensics | Cybersecurity Researcher
profile.summary: Cybersecurity enthusiast focused on Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR), Security Operations (SOC), and Threat Detection. Currently pursuing BCA. Areas of interest include DFIR, Windows & Linux Forensics, Windows Event Log and Sysmon Analysis, Network Forensics and PCAP Analysis, Memory Forensics, Threat Hunting, SIEM Monitoring (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), Malware Analysis Fundamentals, Security Monitoring and Detection Engineering, and Python for Security Automation. Open to Cybersecurity Intern, SOC Analyst, DFIR Intern, Incident Response Intern, Blue Team Analyst, and Entry-Level Security Analyst opportunities.
